# Fixtures for `wim` (Windows Imaging (WIM / SWM / ESD))

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/legacy.sh`.

|---|---|---|

| `saltmere-wimlib.wim` | wimlib-imagex 1.14 (capture, append, image properties; `export --solid` for the ESD) | CC0-1.0 |
